page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration consists of 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512, and AES cryptography.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned in the lower tiers of computational capability. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1161.28, and the multi-core score is 2371.48, both of which are categorized as weak. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 187.49 GB/sec, but uncached large block read and write speeds drop significantly to 22.38 GB/sec and 19.14 GB/sec respectively. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1092.0 and a multi-core score of 1822.0, reflecting poor to weak processing capabilities. Database operations and Redis SET benchmarks also rank in the bottom tier, with Redis achieving 2.61 million operations per second and static web serving throughput reaching 2.58 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the burstable CPU allocation model makes this instance a highly economical choice for entry-level workloads that experience sporadic resource demands. The primary tradeoff is the burstable CPU credit system, which limits sustained high-performance execution, as evidenced by the weak benchmark results across computational, memory, and database tests. This instance is best suited for lightweight workloads such as basic web serving, development environments, low-traffic applications, and simple background tasks that do not require continuous CPU utilization or high network throughput.
